feature_docs: min-max normalized dense (vector) score within the candidate pool [0,1]; 0.0 if the chunk had no dense hit
min-max normalized BM25 score within the candidate pool [0,1]; 0.0 if the chunk had no BM25 hit
min-max normalized raw ripgrep ranked score within the pool [0,1]; 0.0 if no literal hit
raw dense cosine similarity (un-normalized magnitude; confidence, not rank)
raw BM25 score (unbounded; confidence, not rank)
raw ripgrep score for this chunk's file (unbounded; 0.0 if no hit)
the hand-tuned blend alpha*dense_norm+(1-alpha)*sparse_norm (+agreement bonus - supersession penalties) that currently decides rank
max(pool fused_score) - this candidate's fused_score (0.0 for the top candidate)
1/(rank in the hand-tuned fused order), 1-indexed
1/(rank by dense score among pool chunks with a dense hit); 0.0 if the chunk had no dense hit
1/(rank by BM25 score among pool chunks with a BM25 hit); 0.0 if the chunk had no BM25 hit
1/(rank by ripgrep score among pool chunks with a ripgrep hit); 0.0 if no literal hit
how many of {dense, BM25, ripgrep, flat-dense} returned this chunk (0..4)
1.0 if any query identifier-shaped term appears verbatim (casefolded) in the chunk content
fraction of the query's content words (len>=4, non-stopword) present in the chunk content
log1p(len(chunk content))
log1p(total characters of the whole source document); 0.0 when the corpus context is absent
log1p(days since the document date, vs a fixed reference); -1.0 when the document is undated
markdown heading depth of the chunk (# count in its heading path)
1.0 when the chunk is dominated by fenced/inline code, else 0.0
1.0 when the chunk declares ITSELF stale (supersession flag), else 0.0
log1p(max entity fan-in over entities mentioned in the chunk); 0.0 without a graph context
fraction of query identifier terms that are entity names attached to the chunk; 0.0 without a graph context
